title: The geometric representative on a single coefficient
statement: For a commutative ring A in Type(u+1), f:Z -> W a scheme morphism in universe u, A-module sheaves M on W and N on Z, and k:F(M) ~= N, the composite exact-derived comparison L(F)(M[0]) ~= F_derived(M[0]), the mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor comparison, and k[0] equals g(single M) followed by Q of the ordinary single-complex comparison and single(k). Here F is exact inverse image and g is the geometric representative [def-pur-scalar-pullback-representative-data].

proof.text: Use scalarGeometricRepresentative_exact to factor the geometric representative through the canonical exact-derived comparison. Apply mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor_hom_app_eq to its single-complex factor. The single functor to the derived category is single followed by Q, so functoriality of Q identifies the remaining composite with Q of the ordinary single-complex comparison followed by single(k).

lean.statement:
theorem upperStar_single_coefficient_representative
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] {Z W : Scheme.{u}} (f : Z ⟶ W)
    {M : Sheaf W.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)}
    {N : Sheaf Z.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)}
    (k : (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).obj M ≅ N) :
    (upperStarSingleCoefficientIso A f k).hom =
    scalarGeometricRepresentative A f ((HomologicalComplex.single _ (.up ℤ) 0).obj M) ≫
      DerivedCategory.Q.map
        ((HomologicalComplex.singleMapHomologicalComplex
          (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f) (.up ℤ) 0).hom.app M ≫
            (HomologicalComplex.single _ (.up ℤ) 0).map k.hom)
